THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS — NATIVE ANDROID APPLICATION

This list describes the resolved production runtime for this preview, not build
plugins or instrumentation-only dependencies. Component licenses are independent
of this application's AGPL license. Upstream source notices remain applicable.

The following artifacts declare Apache License 2.0 in their official Maven POMs.
The full license is included as Apache-2.0.txt, copied verbatim from OkHttp's
parent-5.5.1 LICENSE.txt (also identical to the verified Okio and Kotlin licenses).
